thread:
alessandra-rossi: Hi payroll team  my Nov 30 paystub shows both INPS and German social deductions (Rentenversicherung + Krankenversicherung) for the same pay period. I moved to Berlin on 2025-11-18 and expected only German withholdings. Net is much lower :frowning:
europe-payroll: Sorry @alessandra-rossi. Can you DM a redacted screenshot or paste the stub lines here?
alessandra-rossi: Pasting redacted lines: 
```
Period: 2025-11-16 to 2025-11-30
Gross: 4,500.00 EUR
INPS employee: -520.00 EUR
IRPEF: -420.00 EUR
German Rentenversicherung: -210.00 EUR
German Krankenversicherung: -190.00 EUR
Lohnsteuer: -330.00 EUR
Net paid: 2,xxx.xx
```
germany-payroll: Thanks. Looks like two payroll rows were exported for the November run: an Italian resident row (full period) and a new German starter row because HR created the Berlin hire before we suppressed the Italy export. That produces duplicate social security and tax on overlapping days.
hr-relocations: Relocation ticket shows notice on 2025-11-12 and Workday location updated 2025-11-17. The A1 certificate request was submitted but still pending; I think the Italy termination flag wasn't applied to the payroll feed before the run closed.
payroll-bot: Ticket created: PR-42189 "Overlap INPS + German Sozialversicherung on alessandra-rossi Nov 2025". Assigned to GlobalPay ops. ETA provider ack 48h.
finance-ops: Please quantify the shortfall so we can approve a one-time net relief if needed.
europe-payroll: Estimated shortfall ~700 EUR after FX and deductions. Operational plan: 1) request Italy provider to reverse INPS/IRPEF for post-termination days, 2) request German provider to confirm Lohnsteuer reporting and amend if needed, 3) post a correcting adjustment on the Dec payroll showing reversal + net make-whole, 4) coordinate employer-side contributions (e.g., avoid double employer Sozialversicherung) and ensure TFR/TFR-like items aren't misposted.
tax-advisor: Note on A1: if an A1 certificate covers the period, INPS may be appropriate; otherwise social security follows residence. For mid-month moves we determine the effective social security residency date and correct reporting. Refund timelines vary: Italy reclaims 4-10 weeks; German corrections commonly 4-8 weeks depending on provider. Keep all stubs and relocation docs.
alessandra-rossi: Will this impact my Certificazione Unica or German Lohnsteuerbescheinigung at year-end? I'm worried about conflicting annual statements.
europe-payroll: Yes corrections will be reflected on both year-end statements. We'll prepare a reconciliation pack for your tax advisor and provide the corrected paystubs and provider ticket numbers.
hr-relocations: I'll escalate the A1 follow-up with the mobility desk and request expedited processing. Also adding a pre-payroll "termination confirmed" gate to the relocation checklist to prevent mid-run overlap.
payroll-bot: PR-42189 updated: provider acknowledged, awaiting reversal docs.
finance-ops: Approving provisional one-time net reimbursement up to 750 EUR pending provider confirmation. Mark it "relocation shortfall" and non-recurring.
europe-payroll: We'll aim to post the net make-whole on Dec payroll if provider delays. If the refund is processed sooner we'll reconcile earlier. We will attach corrected paystub and provider ticket when completed.
alessandra-rossi: Thank you all  please CC me when you have the corrected stub. I can provide any docs needed for the A1 follow-up. :pray:
